system.description: Unobserved by anyone outside your party, spend 1 Fabula Point to assume the appearance of a humanoid seen within the past two days; +(SL) to impersonation Checks. Lasts until dropped or seen through; the Mask never covers a Guise's Tell; stacks with the Many Faces Perk (the Perk gives the face, this gives the performance).
